text:
oncall-bot: PAGED: P1 - svc-discovery errors in azc impacting internal SRV lookups. PagerDuty incident 4452. Escalation: oncall SRE

maria.k: hitting 502/504s from router->model-proxy in azc, spikes started ~20m ago. customer-facing inference latency = up. Root cause looks like SRV records not resolving for model-alloc service.

jake.sre: looking at coredns in azc, some pods in CrashLoopBackOff and high latency on DNS queries. running: `kubectl get pods -n infra | grep coredns` shows 2/5 ready.

abby-platform: Consul shows leader churn in azc: logs show repeated raft timeouts. suspicious after yesterday's peering update.

maria.k: tagging support for customer impact — a few enterprise tenants in us-east are hitting timeouts on hosted API. not all requests but a significant tail.

ops-bot: Incident created: https://redwood.incidents/4452 — please add runbook notes.

jake.sre: quick mitigation options: 1) scale coredns replicas to 8 in azc, 2) force restart unhealthy coredns pods, 3) switch router SRV fallback to cross-az resolver pool (temporary). leaning to 2+3 to minimize blast.

maria.k: agree. do 3 first (router fallback) to reduce customer impact, then do restart. can anyone flip routing? eng-runtime? @eng-runtime

eng-runtime: I can trigger a routing policy change. plan: update service-discovery policy to prefer azb/aze resolvers for 5m with automatic revert. command: `rctl route set --policy srv-prefer=azb,aze --ttl 300 --dry-run=false`

jake.sre: running restart now for unhealthy coredns pods: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/coredns-azc` — will monitor.

(5 min later)

jake.sre: restart completed, pods coming back. logs show initial backlog of queries processed. sample coredns log:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:02Z coredns[1]: proxy: upstream timed out for SRV query (svc model-alloc.azc.internal)
2026-03-15T14:12:15Z coredns[1]: panic: runtime: lock order violation
```
we still have raft chatter on consul though.

eng-runtime: routing policy applied. telemetry shows DNS error rate in azc dropping ~40% after fallback. latency tail improved on some routes.

abby-platform: spinning up a temporary consul follower in azc to stabilise raft quorum — starting new vm and joining. will post join logs.

paul-support: noted major customer impact for two enterprise accounts. opening support tickets and advising degraded performance, no data loss.

(15 min later)

abby-platform: new consul follower joined, raft term stabilized. consul logs now show steady heartbeats. monitoring shows SRV success rates back to normal in azc.

maria.k: running synthetic probes across routers — SRV resolution success 99.8% now vs 82% at peak. good. I'll start incremental rollback of routing fallback in 5m if metrics remain stable.

eng-runtime: beginning rollback: `rctl route unset --policy srv-prefer` — will observe for 10m before full revert.

jake.sre: leave restart cooldown for coredns deployment for 30m to watch for re-occurrence. collecting coredns core dumps to triage the panic trace.

ops-bot: Pager update: mitigated — SRV resolution restored in azc, incidence downgraded to P2. Documentation link: runbook/consul-raft-coredns.

maria.k: postmortem owners: jake.sre (infra), abby-platform (consul), eng-runtime (routing). timeline notes: peering update yesterday likely changed latencies and exposed a raft timeout window. action items: (1) add consul heartbeat alert with 30s threshold, (2) add coredns pod memory limit increase + OOM/stack-trace capture, (3) add automated router fallback for SRV failures.

paul-support: support communicated status to affected customers and will follow up with RCA draft.

jake.sre: saving logs/artifacts to /var/incident/4452/ and creating gist with sanitized stack traces. will start a deeper debug session on the coredns panic tomorrow morning.

maria.k: great work team. closing paging rotation. please ack this thread when you've added notes to the incident. :thumbsup:

jake.sre: acked, added triage notes.

abby-platform: acked, starting postmortem draft.

eng-runtime: acked, policy revert and metrics attached.

paul-support: acked, tickets created for customers.

oncall-bot: Incident 4452 status: RESOLVED -> monitoring.
